The Creator Lane is looking for a highly organized, detail-oriented Social Media Manager & Administrative Assistant to help keep daily operations running smoothly. This is a behind-the-scenes role supporting both the business and personal brand of the founder, with responsibilities spanning bookkeeping, inbox management, social media administration, and general business organization.. 

If you enjoy creating order from chaos, staying on top of details, and working across a variety of tasks, this role is for you.

Responsibilities

Keep QuickBooks accurate and current: transactions reconciled, records clean, categories correct

Run multiple inboxes end to end: triage, timely responses, and a filing system 

Schedule and manage content across social platforms

Monitor and respond to inbound DMs on social platforms in founder’s voice

Maintain the digital asset and file management system 

Run recurring operations through Claude (Cowork and Dispatch) and the automation stack: briefings, file organization, reporting pulls, and first-draft comms, with human review before anything goes out

Document your own processes and turn founder’s voice memos and screen recordings into polished SOPs that train the team and keep the operation repeatable

Support day-to-day admin and organization across the business

Improve the workflows you touch, not just execute them

Handle the miscellaneous work that comes with a growing operation

What You Bring

Hands-on experience with QuickBooks or comparable bookkeeping software

Fluency with AI. You already use Claude (Cowork, Dispatch) or comparable agents to move faster

An instinct for turning messy inputs, a voice memo or a loose process, into clean, followable documentation

Organizational instinct and complete attention to detail 

Clear, precise written communication

The ability to hold multiple priorities without dropping any

Working fluency with social platforms and current best practices

A proactive, self-directed operator comfortable working independently

Experience supporting founders or creators is a strong plus

Requirements

Available and responsive during standard U.S. business hours

Reliable internet and a functional home office setup

Complete discretion with sensitive business and financial information

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and enjoys building systems that make a fast-moving business more efficient. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable reconciling transactions in QuickBooks, organizing inboxes, and making sure nothing slips through the cracks in day-to-day operations.

title: Senior Video Editor for Meta Ads (Premiere / Final Cut / DaVinci) - Long-Term
description:
**About us



We're a US-based creative agency producing video ads for pool builders and outdoor living contractors. We run a systemized creative operation with scripts, footage, and editor notes handed off cleanly through ClickUp and 
. This is a long-term seat on a growing team. We are not looking for gig work or a freelancer juggling five clients.



**What you'll be doing



You'll cut short-form direct response video ads for Meta and Instagram from raw footage, a written script, and editor notes. Expect roughly 4 to 8 ads/content per week once you're up to speed, with revision rounds handled through 
.



**What you must already know how to do



This is not an entry-level role. You should be able to do all of the following without being taught:



- Color grade raw and log footage properly. We shoot log, and you need to know what to do with it.

- Speed ramping, in the style of high-end real estate and property videos

- Audio configuration: levels, cleanup, music balance, mixing that doesn't clip

- Animated text and kinetic typography that actually looks designed, not templated

- Cut for retention. You need to understand hooks, pacing, and why a video flows the way it does. We care more about this than anything else on the list.



**Nice to have, not required



-After Effects

-3D animation or 3D text



**Software



You must be fluent in Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or DaVinci Resolve. We are not hiring CapCut editors.



***Requirements



- Proven experience editing video ads specifically. Wedding, YouTube long-form, and real estate reels alone won't cut it here.

- A computer that can handle 4K log and raw footage without crawling

- Stable, fast internet for downloading large footage files

- Clear written and spoken English

- Some overlap with US Eastern time for handoffs and calls

- Exclusive to us. During the part-time phase you may not work with any competing agency or home services client. Once you move to full-time, this becomes fully exclusive.



**Hours and pay



Starting at 20 hours per week at $10 to $15 per hour depending on experience, moving to full-time for the right person. 



**Our hiring process



1. Portfolio review. If your profile has no portfolio, you will not be considered. No exceptions.



2. Interview with a live editing test. A video call where we go deep on your process. During the call we will send you a raw log clip and ask you to share your screen, open your editing software, and color grade it while walking us through your thinking. Please be ready to screen share from the machine you actually edit on.



3. Paid test edit. We give you raw footage and a brief and you cut the ad. We pay $25 for this regardless of outcome. The final decision is made here.



We're serious about this role and we're taking our time to find the right person. If that's you, we'll be a great long-term home.



**How to apply



Applications missing any of these will be skipped:



1. Start your message with the word PATIO so we know you read the whole post.

2. Link 1 to 2 short-form video ads you personally edited. Not a montage showreel. Tell us what you were given and what you d
 in the edit.

3. Show us one example of your color grading work on log or raw footage.

4. Tell us your computer specs and your internet speed.

5. In 2 to 3 sentences, tell us what makes a hook stop the scroll.

6. Tell us your expected hourly rate.

title: AI Systems Architect & Automation Engineer
description:
About AirUs



AirUs is a rapidly growing UK short-term rental and property management company currently managing approximately 25 properties, with plans to grow beyond 150.



We are not looking to build a simple chatbot or a collection of disconnected automations.



Our vision is to build the AirUs Intelligence Platform: a secure, scalable and continuously improving intelligence layer that supports every major area of the business.



The platform should automate repetitive work, identify inefficiencies, predict problems, challenge existing processes and provide management with evidence-based recommendations.



Our long-term objective is to operate significantly more properties without increasing headcount at the same rate.



This is a long-term opportunity to help design and build an ambitious platform from the ground up.





The Role



We are looking for an experienced AI Systems Architect & AI Automation Engineer to work directly with the CEO.



This is a hands-on role combining:



Systems architecture

AI engineering

Workflow automation

Data integration

Browser automation

Business process improvement



You will not simply be given a list of automations to build.



You will be expected to understand business problems, challenge weak processes, recommend better solutions and build reliable systems that produce measurable results.



The platform will be developed in controlled phases, starting with the foundations and highest-value workflows before expanding across the wider business.





Our Vision



We want AI that:



Thinks critically

Identifies operational bottlenecks

Detects risks and anomalies

Predicts problems before they happen

Challenges inefficient processes

Automates repetitive work

Recommends practical improvements

Improves profitability and operational quality

Reduces unnecessary costs

Helps management make better decisions

Learns from previous decisions and outcomes



Instead of simply reporting:



Occupancy is 84%.



The system should be capable of explaining:



Occupancy is currently 84%, which is six percentage points below target. Four properties account for most of the shortfall. Reducing the minimum stay from three nights to two at those properties is projected to increase monthly NET profit by approximately £2,300.



Recommendations must be based on reliable data and should include assumptions, confidence levels, risks and approval requirements.





What We Intend to Build



The AirUs Intelligence Platform will eventually support:



Executive reporting

Finance and reconciliation

Property operations

Guest communications

Client communications

Cleaning and laundry management

Maintenance

Renovations and procurement

Recruitment

HR and training

Property and client onboarding

Listing creation

Revenue management

Growth and sales

Marketing

Compliance

Quality assurance

Business intelligence

Knowledge and decision management



We do not expect all of this to be built immediately. The successful candidate will help us prioritise and implement the platform systematically.





Key Responsibilities

Design the technical architecture of the AirUs Intelligence Platform

Translate business requirements into reliable technical solutions

Build advanced n8n workflows

Develop AI-assisted workflows and specialist AI agents

Build browser automations using Playwright where APIs are unavailable

Integrate business systems through APIs, webhooks and reusable connectors

Design PostgreSQL data models

Implement RAG and knowledge-retrieval systems where appropriate

Connect AI models securely to authorised business data

Build dashboards and executive reporting

Implement human approval processes for sensitive actions

Create error handling, retries, logging and alerting

Test workflows before production deployment

Monitor and improve existing automations

Protect the platform from unnecessary vendor dependency

Maintain clear technical documentation

Identify and quantify further automation opportunities

Challenge requests that are insecure, unreliable or unnecessarily complex

Architecture Principles



The platform must be:



Secure by design

Modular

Vendor independent

Well documented

Observable

Testable

Cost conscious

Easy to maintain

Capable of supporting future growth



External systems such as PMS platforms, accounting software and AI providers should connect through replaceable integrations rather than becoming embedded in the platform’s core business logic.





Required Technical Experience



You should have strong practical experience with most of the following:



n8n

OpenAI APIs

Anthropic Claude APIs

AI workflow or agent development

REST APIs

Webhooks

Playwright or equivalent browser automation

Python

JavaScript and/or TypeScript

PostgreSQL or a comparable relational database

Vector databases and RAG

Git and version control

Docker

Cloud or VPS deployment

Authentication and secrets management

Logging, monitoring and error handling

Business process automation



Experience with Langdock and Model Context Protocol is beneficial but not essential.





Relevant Integration Experience



Experience integrating any of the following would be valuable:



Property Management Systems

Airbnb



Stripe

QuickBooks

Google Workspace

Microsoft 365

WhatsApp Business

Ring

Minut

Canva

Social media platforms



Direct experience with short-term rentals is useful but not required.





Minimum Requirements



To be considered, you must:



Have at least two years of relevant commercial automation, software or AI engineering experience

Be able to demonstrate systems you personally designed or built

Have excellent written and spoken English at CEFR C1 level or above

Be comfortable working independently

Be proactive and commercially minded

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills

Understand that reliable automation requires testing, monitoring and maintenance

Be willing to document your work thoroughly

Be comfortable receiving and giving constructive challenge



Exceptional candidates with less experience may still be considered where they can demonstrate unusually strong technical ability and ownership.



The Person We Are Looking For



We want someone who:



Loves solving difficult business problems

Thinks beyond the task they have been given

Investigates the root cause before building a solution

Challenges inefficient or unnecessary processes

Builds scalable systems instead of fragile quick fixes

Understands the difference between a prototype and a production system

Takes security and data privacy seriously

Considers failure scenarios before deployment

Communicates technical subjects clearly

Takes ownership of outcomes

Continuously asks: “How can we make this better?”



If you prefer waiting for detailed instructions before taking action, this role is unlikely to suit you.





Application Instructions



Begin your application with the following code:



AirUsAI25^



Applications that do not begin with this exact code will not be considered.



Please answer every question below.



1. Previous system



Tell us about the most advanced AI automation, AI agent or integrated system you personally designed and built.



Explain:



The business problem

The architecture

The tools used

Your personal contribution

How it was tested

The measurable result

What you would improve now



2. First AirUs project



Based on this job description, what would be the first system or workflow you would build for AirUs and why?



Explain what information you would need before making the final decision.



3. Process improvement



Describe a business process you significantly improved using AI or automation.



What changed and what measurable benefit was achieved?



4. Architecture



How would you prevent a business from becoming dependent on one PMS, AI provider or automation developer?



5. Reliability



Describe an automation you built that failed or behaved unexpectedly.



What caused the failure, how did you resolve it and what safeguards did you introduce?



6. AI understanding



Explain the difference between:



A chatbot

An AI-assisted workflow

An AI agent

A deterministic automation



Give an appropriate business use case for each.



7. Experience ratings



Rate your experience from 1–10 and briefly justify each score:



n8n

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

Playwright or similar browser automation

Python

JavaScript or TypeScript

PostgreSQL

APIs and webhooks

Docker and deployment

RAG and vector databases



8. Difficult problem



Describe the most technically difficult problem you have solved and how you approached it.



9. Security



How would you securely manage production credentials, customer data and developer access for a system like this?



10. Previous work



Share links to your GitHub, portfolio, demonstrations or previous AI projects where available.



Clearly explain which parts you personally completed.





Why Join AirUs?



This is not another role building isolated automations from a predefined task list.



You will have the opportunity to help design and build an intelligence platform that could transform how an entire company operates.



You will work directly with the CEO, influence important architectural decisions and build systems that are used in real business operations.



We are looking for someone who wants long-term ownership of something meaningful and is excited by the challenge of turning an ambitious vision into a secure, reliable and commercially valuable platform.

About the role

What this is not:

This is not client-facing — no calls,
s, or messages to the client, ever

title: Lead Video Editor & Post Production Manager
description:
About the Role



The Creator Lane is looking for an experienced Lead Video Editor & Project Manager to oversee our remote editing team and ensure every client project is delivered on time, on brand, and at a consistently high creative standard.

This role sits at the intersection of creative leadership and operational execution. You will manage a team of editors working across multiple client channels, review their work, provide feedback, maintain production standards, and build systems that allow the editing department to scale.



You will be the quality control layer between our editors and our clients: making sure timelines are met, creative direction is followed, files are organized, and every video leaving the team represents the quality The Creator Lane is known for.

If you are an exceptional editor who also enjoys leading people, building workflows, and turning a creative team into a well-run production machine, this role is for you.



What You'll Own:

- Manage and support a remote team of video editors working across multiple client projects

- Working directly with the founder in launching his personal branded channels and establishing his content’s editing style as his lead editor. 

- Fill in gaps on editing projects to hit deadlines as needed

- Assign projects, track progress, and ensure all deliverables are completed on schedule

- Review edits for storytelling, pacing, retention, technical quality, and alignment with each client's established brand style

- Provide clear, actionable revision notes and creative feedback to editors

- Maintain consistent editing standards across all channels and client accounts

- Own project organization: file structures, assets, submissions, revisions, and final deliverables

- Monitor production timelines and proactively identify bottlenecks before they impact deadlines

- Create and improve editing workflows, systems, and processes as the team grows

- Collaborate with leadership to refine creative direction and improve output quality

- Step in on priority edits or complex projects when needed

- Help develop editors through feedback, coaching, and creative guidance

- Work directly with founder to share progress updates and take feedback on close to final edits to be completed by editing staff



What You Bring:

- Proven experience as a professional video editor with a strong portfolio

- Previous experience managing, leading, or mentoring a creative team

- Strong understanding of YouTube, social media content, storytelling, and audience retention

- Advanced proficiency in video editing software (Adobe Premiere Pro required; After Effects experience is a plus)

- Strong creative judgment and the ability to identify what makes content engaging

- Exceptional organization and project management skills

- Ability to communicate feedback clearly and respectfully while maintaining high standards

- Experience managing remote workflows and collaborating through digital tools

- A proactive mindset: you don't just identify problems, you build solutions



Requirements:

- Available and responsive during standard U.S. business hours

- Reliable internet and a functional home office setup

- Ability to manage multiple projects, editors, and deadlines simultaneously

- Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality work



Who Thrives Here



This role is built for someone who understands that great creative teams need more than great editors — they need leadership, systems, and accountability. You are someone who can spot the weak points in a video, give an editor the exact feedback needed to improve it, and build the workflow that prevents the same issues from happening again.



You care about the details: organized project files, clean submissions, clear communication, and deadlines that actually get hit. You enjoy developing people, improving processes, and creating an environment where editors can do their best work.

title: AI Product Image Generator (Fashion) — Growth Path to Department Head
description:
AI Product Image Generator (Fashion) — Growth Path to Department Head



Part-time to start, Full-time soon

Pay: $0.50 per product (photo set), increasing fast — see growth path below to monthly salary position

Working Hours: Flexible, full time, deadline-based





IMPORTANT — READ FIRST:



This role is 100% attention to detail. If you skim job posts and apply without reading, this is not the job for you — you will not last a week. To prove you read this fully, start your application with the word "PRECISE" in the subject line. Applications without it will not be opened.





About the Role:



We run fashion dropshipping stores and are scaling fast. Our product lister handles everything about a new product EXCEPT the images — that's you. You take the original product photo and use it to generate new, professional-looking images of the product on our own models, using an online generation tool we will show you once onboarded . We provide the account, no cost to you.



You will follow a detailed step-by-step SOP that covers:



- How to select the right reference model for each product type (dresses, tops, bottoms, outerwear, swimwear)

- How to prompt correctly so the AI keeps the right silhouette, length, and fit

- How to generate a full set of poses per product (front, side, back, close-up, flat lay, editorial)

- How to handle multiple color/style variants efficiently

- How to export and organize final images for Shopify



The SOP is thorough, but AI tools are imperfect — the product it generates won't always match the original exactly (wrong length, wrong color, wrong detail). Your job is to catch that, fix it, and regenerate until it's accurate. This is where the real skill is: knowing when something is "off" and not letting it slip through.



Pay Potential (read this before dismissing $0.50/product):



This is not as low as it sounds. At a strong, precise pace, most people can complete 12-15 product image sets per hour — that works out to $6-7.50/hour, which is on par with or above what most product listing VA jobs pay ($2-5/hour). Our daily target is 30 products (roughly 2-3 focused hours of work), and once you're experienced, some people push to 50/day if they want the extra pay. We're not asking for 50/day as a requirement — we'd rather have 30 done with zero mistakes than 50 with sloppy ones.



What We Need From You:



- Sharp eye for detail — able to spot when a generated image doesn't match the original product (fit, color, fabric, length)

- Patience to regenerate/revise until it's right, without cutting corners

- Ability to follow a structured SOP exactly, and flag when something in the SOP doesn't work for a specific product

- Reliable daily output — hitting the realistic target of discussed amount of fully-precise product image sets per day once trained

- No prior design/Photoshop experience needed — this is a trainable skill, not a portfolio job. What matters is precision and consistency, not creativity.



Training:



Expect 1-2 days to get comfortable with the tool and workflow. It's straightforward once you've done it a handful of times, but it IS time-consuming — this is a volume + precision job, not a fast one.



Growth Path (this matters — read this part):



This is not a flat piece-rate job forever. As we scale, we'll be uploading 50-100 products/day across stores, which is far more than one person can handle at the precision level we require. We need someone from this role to grow into **Head of Image Generation**, meaning:



- Onboarding and training new image generators

- Reviewing their output for quality before it goes live

- Owning the department's consistency and speed as we scale



Whoever proves they can do this role at a high standard will move into that position with a fixed monthly salary on top of increased per-product rates for the team's output — not just $0.50/unit forever. We're hiring the first person into this role specifically because we want to promote from within, not because we want a rotating door of freelancers.



How to Apply:



Include the word "PRECISE" in your subject line. In your application, tell us:

1. Have you used any AI image tools before? If yes, which ones.

2. Describe a time in a past job where attention to detail mattered and you caught a mistake others missed.

3. Are you comfortable with a role that starts as piece-rate but has a clear path to a fixed salary + leadership position?



We will do an interview selection process, send the full SOP and a short paid trial batch to shortlisted applicants before final hire.



MS INDUSTRIES LLC

title: Administration & Client Concierge Coordinator
description:
About JLX Entertainment

JLX Entertainment is a premium events entertainment company delivering DJ, MC, and live music experiences for weddings, corporate functions, and private events across Melbourne and beyond. We're a fast-moving, high-volume operation with a strong brand, a growing roster of talent, and a client experience standard we take seriously. This role sits at the centre of that experience.

Role Overview

The Administration & Client Concierge Coordinator is the operational backbone of JLX Entertainment's client and talent experience. You are the first and most consistent touchpoint for booked clients — the “online concierge” who ensures every client feels supported, informed, and organised from booking through to event delivery.

You will manage all front-end client correspondence, keep 100+ active clients moving smoothly through their event pipeline, coordinate talent paperwork and scheduling, and own the administrative systems that keep the business running. Your job is to handle the details so the Director and sales team can focus on high-value conversations and event delivery.

This is not a sales or lead qualification role — leads are qualified by our sales team. Your role begins once a client is booked in, and your job is to make everything after that point seamless.

Key Responsibilities

Client Correspondence & Concierge Support

• Act as the primary point of contact for all booked client enquiries via

• Answer client questions regarding service hours, inclusions, and booking details

• Filter and manage inbound correspondence so that only decision-required matters reach the Director or sales team

• Uphold the principle that no decisions are made over
 — schedule clients into calls with the appropriate tea
mber when decisions or detailed discussions are needed

• Ensure every client interaction reflects JLX's premium brand standard

Pipeline & Client Management

• Manage 50–100 new leads per month entering the system, ensuring each is placed and progressed correctly

• Maintain accurate pipeline stages for 100+ active clients based on where they sit relative to their event date

• Monitor client touchpoints and proactively manage follow-ups, ensuring no client falls through the cracks despite irregular contact rhythms

• Prepare client details and context ahead of scheduled calls so the team walks in fully informed

Talent Administration

• Prepare and send all talent paperwork (booking confirmations, agreements, event details)

• Set up and manage calendar invites for talent across all booked events

• Ensure talent have complete, accurate, and timely information for every engagement

Calendar & Scheduling

• Manage the Director's calendar, including client calls, talent bookings, and internal commitments

• Schedule client calls with the sales team and Director as required

• Coordinate scheduling across multiple events and stakeholders without conflicts

Database & Systems Administration

• Maintain accurate records across Google Sheets (including the DJ database), Google Drive, and Google Calendar

• Keep event folders, client information, and booking data organised and up to date

• Execute recurring administrative processes and identify opportunities to streamline them

Skills & Experience Required

• 2+ years' experience in an administration, coordination, executive assistant, or client service role

• Exceptional written communication — professional, warm, and clear
 correspondence is the core of this role

• Strong proficiency with Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Calendar, Gmail)

• Proven ability to manage high volumes of concurrent clients, tasks, or bookings without dropping details

• Excellent organisational skills and a systems-oriented mindset

• Comfortable working autonomously and taking full ownership of administrative outcomes

• Sound judgement on what to handle independently versus what to escalate

Nice to Have

• Experience in events, entertainment, hospitality, or weddings

• Familiarity with CRM platforms (e.g. GoHighLevel or similar)

• Experience supporting a founder or small business owner directly

• Understanding of client lifecycle or pipeline management

What Success Looks Like

• Clients consistently feel looked after — questions answered promptly, details always correct

• The Director's inbox and calendar run themselves; only genuine decisions reach his desk

• Every client is in the right pipeline stage at the right time, with zero clients slipping through the cracks

• Talent paperwork and calendars are always accurate, complete, and sent on time

• The sales team and Director walk into every call fully briefed

Why Join JLX

You'll be joining a growing entertainment brand with a clear vision, working directly with the founder in a role with real ownership and impact. This is a position for someone who takes pride in being the person who keeps everything running — the one everyone relies on.



To apply, please share a link to your resume and a short cover note outlining your relevant experience.

You report to the Content Strategist who sets the creative direction and generates the ideas. Your job is to bring those ideas to life - editing, designing, scheduling, publishing, tracking performance, and keeping the entire production machine running smoothly.



This is a full-time remote position. We are looking for a fast, detail-oriented executor who can produce high-quality short-form content at volume, manage publishing workflows across multiple platforms, and actively use AI tools to increase speed and output. A genuine interest in health, beauty, and strong visual aesthetics is essential - this is the world we operate in, and you need to live and breathe it.



Responsibilities

- Produce 2 to 3 short-form videos and supporting graphics per day, including editing, trimming, captioning, and polishing content for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

- Execute on creative briefs and direction provided by the Content Strategist, turning concepts into finished, platform-ready assets.

- Design on-brand visuals such as carousels, text graphics, thumbnails, and infographics that support the creator's style and messaging.

- Plan, schedule, and publish short-form content across all platforms while maintaining a balanced mix of educational, inspirational, and trend-based formats.

- Follow short-form trends including audio, hooks, captions, and editing styles, and flag relevant opportunities to the Content Strategist.

- Monitor performance metrics weekly and provide insights, recommendations, and data summaries based on watch time, retention, views, and engagement.

- Source and organize trending sounds, audio, and reference content to support the Content Strategist's ideation process.

- Coordinate collaboration posts and identify smart opportunities for creator crossovers and partnership content.

- Keep systems clean in Asana and Google Drive, ensuring clear task ownership, file naming, version control, and a predictable content runway.

- Use AI tools to streamline editing, captioning, clipping, and repurposing workflows to increase daily output and reduce turnaround time.

- Continuously improve and document production workflows to increase the efficiency and scalability of the content system.



Requirements

- 3+ years of experience creating and publishing short-form content for Instagram, TikTok, and/or YouTube Shorts with proven results.

- Genuine interest in health, beauty, and aesthetics. You naturally follow this space, understand the visual standards, and have an eye for what looks premium.

- Editing and design expertise in short-form video editing using Premiere Pro, CapCut, or Final Cut, and strong design ability using Canva or Photoshop, including thumbnails, carousels, text graphics, and supporting visuals.

- Strong ability to take creative direction and execute it accurately and quickly with minimal revision cycles.

*** About the Role ***



If you want motion graphics video work that actually matters, this is it!



Engage Video Production (EVP) creates educational and communication-focused video for aerospace, defense, and other technical clients. You will be our primary creator for explainer and motion graphics videos, and the internal design resource that keeps every project sharp, from animated explainers to the diagrams, callouts, and overlays our editors rely on. The work is structured and built for real-world use, not just visuals.



This is a full-time, 40-hour-per-week role working directly with the Creative Director. Aerospace and defense are our core specialties, but our projects vary widely, so we need a designer who is adaptable, technically proficient, and comfortable shifting styles to fit each client's goals.



If you need reminders to respond or follow up, this is not a fit. If you spot issues early, communicate clearly, and take ownership of your work, keep reading.



*** The Three Pillars of Success at EVP ***



To succeed here, you need to live these three values:



Discipline: You follow through on every task without floundering or ghosting. You manage your time and meet deadlines without constant supervision.



Ownership / Initiative: You do more than complete tasks. You look for ways to improve the work and support the team.

Integrity / Accountability: You own your mistakes right away. You have the backbone to point out errors for correction, even your own, because precision here is non-negotiable.



*** Role Overview ***



This is a dual-focus role. You are the primary creator for our explainer and motion graphics videos, and you also produce graphic assets for our standard video team when needed. You will coordinate with our editors to supply the graphic elements, overlays, and design assets each project needs.



*** Core Responsibilities ***



Motion Graphics: Lead the production of full explainer videos, from storyboarding and asset creation to final animation.



Collaborative Design: Act as the internal design resource for our video editors. You will build the lower thirds, callouts, and technical diagrams their edits need.



Web and Digital Assets: Design high-fidelity web page elements and marketing collateral that fit our brand and our clients' technical standards.



Brand Consistency: Hold a high level of quality across every visual touchpoint, with a clean, professional, and sophisticated look.



Communication: This is part of the job, not an extra. Send progress updates as needed, flag blockers early and suggest solutions, and stay aligned with the Creative Director and company priorities. Silent work does not fly here.



*** Required Qualifications ***



Technical Stack: Proficiency in Adobe After Effects, Illustrator, and Photoshop, or similar motion and design software.



Portfolio: A strong reel of explainer and motion graphics work, plus a portfolio of clean, functional graphic design (web elements, technical icons, diagrams).



Coordination: You can work alongside editors and give them the assets they need to hit their timelines.

Autonomy and Communication: Excellent written English and a proactive approach to reporting. You work without micromanagement and stay vocal about timelines, challenges, and progress.



*** Bonus / Preferred Skills ***



- 3D motion or design (Cinema 4D, Blender, or similar)

- Technical illustration or data and diagram visualization

- Brand and identity design

- Experience with technical, educational, or corporate content

- Familiarity with 
 or structured feedback workflows

- Interest in aerospace, defense, or technical subjects



*** Compensation ***



Hourly Rate: $4.00 to $10.00 USD per hour. Your starting rate depends on experience and demonstrated skill.

This is a full-time role and full-time is what we are after. That said, if you are clearly qualified but can only commit part-time right now, apply anyway and tell us your availability.



Full-Time (40 hrs/week): $640 to $1,600 USD per month (about 39,000 to 98,000 PHP).

Part-Time (20 hrs/week): $320 to $800 USD per month (about 20,000 to 49,000 PHP).

[*Conversions are approximate.]



*** A Note on AI and Judgment ***



At EVP, we use advanced tools every day. But this role requires real human judgment and radical integrity. We are hiring a human, not a prompt.



If you use AI to draft your personal responses in the "How to Apply" section, you fail the first test of this role: honesty. We want your real thoughts and your real personality so we can tell whether you fit our team. If your application has no genuine human voice, it will be discarded. Use AI to assist your workflow later. Do not use it to represent your character now.



*** How to Apply ***



Follow these steps exactly. Attention to detail is part of the job.



- Set your subject line to: "Motivated Motion Graphics Artist - [Your Name]"

- Use a minimum of 7 apply points (AP).

- Provide a link to your best motion and static design work. No portfolio means no consideration.

- State the 10th word of our "Three Pillars" section.

- In exactly two sentences, describe a specific time you had to fix a mistake you made in a motion graphics project. Plain English only. No AI-generated fluff.

- Attach or link to your CV/resume in PDF format only.

- Want to stand out? Record a 60-second video (Loom or similar) introducing yourself. Tell me why you are the right pick and what interests you about aerospace and defense. Start the video by addressing me by name (Ryan). Applicants who include this video move to the top of the list.



Thanks for your time and genuine interest!

Our vision is to build an AI Operating System that becomes the intelligence layer of our entire business. We want AI to automate repetitive work, identify inefficiencies, challenge existing processes, provide strategic recommendations and continuously improve the business.

You will help us build intelligent systems that don't just automate work but actively improve how the business operates every day.

Thinks critically.

Predicts problems before they happen.

Continuously suggests improvements.

Automates repetitive work.

Helps management make better decisions.

Finance & reconciliation

Guest communications

Client communications

Listing creation

Property onboarding

Revenue management

Marketing

Compliance

Business intelligence

CEO reporting

Instead of saying:

"Occupancy is currently 84%, which is 6?low target. Four properties account for most of the shortfall. Reducing the minimum stay from three nights to two is projected to increase monthly NET profit by approximately £2,300."

Design scalable AI architecture.

Build AI agents across multiple business functions.

Create advanced n8n workflows.

Integrate multiple systems into one AI ecosystem.

Build dashboards and executive reporting.

Build browser automations where APIs are unavailable.

Connect AI models to business data.

Continuously improve existing workflows.

Identify opportunities for automation.

Challenge existing business processes.

Recommend new AI solutions as the company grows.

Required Skills



You must have experience with most of the following:



n8n

Langdock

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

AI agent development

Prompt engineering

Workflow automation

REST APIs

Webhooks

Browser automation (Playwright or similar)

Python

JavaScript and/or TypeScript

PostgreSQL or similar databases

Vector databases / RAG

Git

Cloud deployment

Business process automation



Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) is a bonus.



Nice to Have



Experience integrating systems such as:



Property Management Systems

Airbnb



Stripe

QuickBooks

Google Workspace

Microsoft 365

WhatsApp Business

Ring

Minut

Canva

Social media platforms

Minimum Requirements



To be considered you must:



Have a minimum of 1 year of commercial experience building AI systems or AI automations.

Have excellent written and spoken English (minimum CEFR C1 level).

Be comfortable working independently.

Be proactive and solution-focused.

Have strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Be passionate about using AI to improve businesses rather than simply writing code.

The Type of Person We're Looking For



We want someone who:



Loves solving difficult business problems.

Thinks beyond the task they've been given.

Challenges inefficient processes.

Suggests better ways of working.

Builds scalable systems instead of quick fixes.

Enjoys learning new technologies.

Takes ownership of projects.

Is excited by building something completely new.



If you simply wait for instructions, this role probably isn't for you.



We want someone who constantly asks:



"How can we make this better?"



Important



To confirm you have carefully read this job description, please begin your application with the following code:



AirUsAI25^



Applications that do not begin with this exact code will not be considered.



Application Questions



Please answer all of the following:



Tell us about the most advanced AI automation, AI agent or AI system you have personally built.



If you joined AirUs tomorrow, what would be the first AI workflow or AI agent you would build and why?



Describe a business process you significantly improved using AI or automation.



Explain the difference between an AI chatbot and an AI agent.



Rate your experience from 1–10 with:

n8n

Langdock

OpenAI APIs

Claude APIs

Browser automation (Playwright or similar)

Python

JavaScript / TypeScript

APIs & Webhooks



Describe the most technically difficult problem you have solved and how you approached it.



Share links to your GitHub, portfolio or previous AI projects (if available).



Why Join Us?



This is not another automation job.



You'll have the opportunity to help design and build an AI Operating System from the ground up that will transform how an entire company operates.



If you're excited by solving real business problems with AI and want to build something that could become an industry-leading platform, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Operations & Growth VA – Airbnb / Booking.com / Short-Term Let Management
description:
Please read this carefully before applying.



We are not looking for a basic VA or someone who only wants easy admin tasks.



We are looking for a reliable, sharp and proactive tea
mber who can support the day-to-day operations and growth of a UK short-term-let management company.



This role is for someone who learns quickly, follows instructions properly, communicates clearly in English and can solve problems without needing constant supervision.



Please do not apply if any of the below apply to you:

Your ID score is below 90

Your English level is below C1

You have less than 1 year of hands-on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience

You are currently working multiple full-time jobs or have commitments that will affect your focus

You cannot work during UK hours

You are not comfortable speaking and writing in English

You need constant step-by-step supervision for every task

You use ChatGPT to write generic answers without understanding the role



About AirUs:

We are a growing UK short-term-let management company.



We manage properties across different cities and work with guests, property owners, cleaners, contractors and booking platforms every day.



Our standards are high. We care about guest experience, owner trust, reviews, revenue, compliance and smooth operations.



This role combines:

Day-to-day operations

Guest communication

Owner support

Cleaner and contractor coordination

Problem solving

SOP improvement

Growth support

Lead follow-up

Client acquisition support



This is a serious long-term role for the right person.



About the role:

You will be helping us keep operations running smoothly while also supporting business growth.



You must be able to:

Think clearly under pressure

Follow instructions properly

Learn quickly

Communicate confidently in English

Take ownership of problems

Spot issues before they become bigger problems

Suggest better ways of working

Use ChatGPT / Claude properly to improve speed and quality

Handle guests, cleaners, owners and leads professionally



This role will start part-time at 20 hours per week at $4 per hour during the initial trial period.



If you prove you are the right person, hours and rate can increase based on performance.



UK working hours are preferred.



Key responsibilities:

Handle guest messages calmly, quickly and professionally

Resolve guest issues within agreed boundaries

Coordinate cleaners, contractors and internal tea
mbers

Check that properties are ready for guest arrivals

Protect reviews, ratings and brand reputation

Update property owners clearly when issues happen

Follow existing SOPs correctly

Create and improve SOPs where needed

Identify recurring problems and help fix the root cause

Follow up leads and potential new clients

Support outreach to landlords, investors and property owners

Help improve systems, templates and workflows

Use ChatGPT / Claude to improve communication, outreach and efficiency



Growth responsibilities



This is not just an inbox role.



We want someone who can also help the business grow.



This may include:

Following up inbound leads

Contacting potential landlords, investors and property owners

Helping with outreach messages

Tracking leads properly

Supporting basic negotiation

Improving owner communication

Helping improve listings and guest experience

Identifying weak points in the business

Suggesting ways to improve revenue, reviews or operations



Required skills and experience:

Minimum 1 year hands-on Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience

Excellent written and spoken English, C1 or above

Strong problem-solving ability

Clear communication

Good judgement under pressure

Strong organisation and time management

Ability to follow instructions exactly

Comfortable using ChatGPT or Claude for real work tasks

Commercial mindset, not just task completion

Confident speaking to guests, cleaners, owners and leads

Proactive and able to work without micromanagement



Nice to have:

Experience with PMS software

Experience with PriceLabs, Beyond or dynamic pricing tools

Experience with CRM or lead tracking

Experience with SOPs and process documentation

Experience with social media, outreach or basic marketing

Experience working with UK, US, Canadian or Australian clients



What success looks like after 90 days:

Guest messages are handled quickly and confidently

Issues are resolved without unnecessary escalation

Owners receive clear and professional updates

Cleaner and contractor communication is organised

SOPs are followed and improved

Leads are followed up consistently

You identify problems before being told

You suggest better ways of working

You become someone the business can rely on



Important application instructions:

To prove you have read the full description, include the word airus26 at the very top of your application.



Then answer the following questions clearly:

Confirm your English level.

Confirm your ID score.

Confirm how many jobs you are currently working.

Confirm your Airbnb, 
, VRBO, Agoda, Expedia or short-term-let experience.



Q1 – Too many tasks at once

You start the day with 15 planned tasks.

By midday, 5 urgent issues appear:

A guest cannot access a property

A cleaner says they cannot attend a same-day turnover

An owner is asking for an urgent update

A new landlord lead is ready for a call

A guest is asking for a refund due to a minor issue



How do you d
 what gets done today and what gets pushed back?



In your answer, explain:

Your priority order

What you handle immediately

What you acknowledge but schedule later

What you escalate

How you make sure nothing gets forgotten

How you communicate delays to stakeholders

What gets moved to tomorrow and why



Q2 – Lead follow-up and growth

A landlord lead spoke to us last week and seemed interested, but has not replied since.

They own a 3-bedroom property in a good area. They told us they are comparing us with another management company and are mainly worried about fees.



What would you do next?



In your answer, explain:

What follow-up message you would send

What value points you would focus on

What proof or reassurance you would provide

How you would avoid sounding desperate

How many times you would follow up before closing the lead

What you would record in the CRM or tracker

What would make this a good or bad lead



Q3 – AI use in operations and growth

We expect this role to use ChatGPT or Claude properly, not lazily.

Give two specific examples of how you would use AI in this role.



Your answer must include:

One example for improving operations

One example for helping business growth

What information you would give the AI

How you would check the output before using it

One thing you would never allow AI to d
 on its own



Applications will be rejected if:

You do not include airus26

You do not answer the questions

Your answers are vague or generic

Your answers look fully copied from ChatGPT

You do not have relevant short-term-let experience

You are working multiple full-time jobs

You cannot work during UK hours



Hiring process:

Shortlisted candidates will proceed to the next stage of the hiring process.



The full hiring process may include:

Further written assessment

Short video test

Practical operations task

Final interview

Paid trial for the strongest candidate



We are looking for someone who is honest, sharp, reliable, fast to learn and serious about building a long-term role with our company.

description:

Full-Time | Long-Term Role



SALARY



- $1,500 per month during Ramp / Trial period. Upon certification (typically 30–60 days), base increases to $2,000.

- On-Target Earnings are $2,500, including a $500 performance bonus (capped).

- Commission on renewals and upsells is uncapped and paid in addition to base and bonus.

- Additional performance-based incentives may apply.



Payment: Twice a month via Wise. Always on time.

ntum.

We sell an “80% done-for-you” content and monetization system helping creators go viral and generate income using short-form content and AI tools.



Most clients are 45+ beginners. They are motivated but often overwhelmed. They need clarity, structure, accountability, and calm leadership.



SCHEDULE



- Full-time, 7.5 hours per day, Monday to Friday.

- You can work your hours in one block or split them, as long as you consistently meet the job requirements.

- You will serve clients during your assigned 7.5-hour shift within our main coverage window (8am ET–2am ET)

- Must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET).



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Manage 40–50 clients after ramp-up (with systems and internal support in place).

- Run structured kickoff calls.

- Set clear expectations from day one.

- Own the client relationship end-to-end.

- Prevent churn and refund requests.

- Identify frustration early and de-escalate calmly.

- Handle difficult conversations professionally.

- Hold clients accountable to next steps.

- Follow up when clients go quiet.

- Ensure clients always know what to do next and why it matters.

- Lead renewal conversations.

- Collect testimonials and referrals.

- Clients should never feel lost. You are responsible for clarity and 
ntum.

HOW YOU WIN



- Clients stay in the program.

- Renewals remain strong.

- Refunds are rare.

- Clients feel clear and stable.

- Difficult situations are handled calmly.



REQUIREMENTS



- Near-native spoken English with very clear pronunciation for U.S.-based clients.

- Confident on Zoom.

- Strong emotional intelligence.

- Calm under pressure.

- High ownership and follow-through.

- Comfortable with uncomfortable conversations.

- Proactive and organized.

- Reliable internet and professional home setup.

- Strong say-do ratio and respect for deadlines.



NICE TO HAVE EXPERIENCE



- Client Success or Account Management

- High-ticket program

- Knowledge of social media monetization.

- Familiarity with AI tools (ChatGPT, CapCut, etc.).



HOW TO APPLY



Apply here: 
/to/Su5De9Qc



IMPORTANT: Put “CSM” + Your Full Name in the Name field.



P.S. Once hired, you will be contracted under Social Influence Consulting LLC.

title: New York Registered Nurse (RN) – Remote | RPM / CCM / RTM Patient Outreach
description:
We're a U.S.-based healthcare company looking for a licensed Registered Nurse to join our remote care team. You'll be the clinical voice reaching out to patients enrolled in Remote Patient Monitoring (RPM), Chronic Care Management (CCM), and Remote Therapeutic Monitoring (RTM) programs. This is a patient-facing role — you'll be speaking directly with patients about their diagnoses, symptoms, device readings, and care plans, not just doing data entry.



Responsibilities:



Conduct outbound calls to enrolled patients for monthly CCM check-ins and RPM/RTM monitoring reviews

Review and discuss vital sign data, device readings, and symptom trends with patients

Educate patients on their diagnosis, medications, and care plan in clear, compassionate language

Document all interactions accurately in the EHR/care management platform to support billing requirements (CPT codes 99457, 99458, 99490, 99491, 98980, 98981, etc.)

Identify red flags or changes in patient condition and escalate to supervising providers as needed

Coordinate with physicians and office staff regarding care plan updates

Track monthly time-based documentation to ensure compliance with CMS billing requirements

Assist with patient enrollment calls and device education as needed



Requirements:



Active Registered Nurse (RN) license (U.S. license preferred; will consider PH-licensed RNs with strong U.S. healthcare/RPM/CCM experience)

Prior experience with RPM, CCM, and/or RTM programs strongly preferred

Excellent spoken and written English communication skills

Comfortable speaking with patients about medical diagnoses, chronic conditions, and treatment plans

Familiarity with U.S. healthcare terminology, EHR systems, and HIPAA basics

Reliable high-speed internet, backup power, headset, and quiet home office setup

Available for full-time hours (40+ hrs/week) during U.S. business hours

Strong documentation and time-management skills — this role requires accurate time tracking for billing compliance



Nice to Have:



Experience working for a U.S. healthcare company or BPO in a clinical/nursing capacity

Familiarity with Athenahealth, or similar RPM/EHR platforms

Background in telehealth or care coordination



To Apply:

Please include: (1) your RN license status and jurisdiction, (2) years of RPM/CCM/RTM experience, (3) a short video recording introducing yourself, and (4) your available start date.

title: E-Commerce CRO & Creative Strategist (Landing Pages + Conversion Optimization)
description:
We’re looking for a high-level E-Commerce CRO & Creative Strategist who knows how to turn traffic into revenue.



This role combines conversion optimization, landing page execution, copywriting, and creative strategy. You must have real experience building landing pages, writing direct response copy, and developing winning creative angles—not just analyzing data.



You should understand why people buy, and how to align messaging, visuals, and offers to drive results.



This is a performance-driven role. We care about results, speed, and execution.



What You’ll Be Doing:



Build and optimize high-converting landing pages (Shopify or similar platforms)

Write and refine direct response copy across landing pages and funnels

Run and manage A/B tests across product pages, funnels, and offers

Analyze user behavior using tools like Microsoft Clarity, heatmaps, and session recordings

Identify drop-off points and conversion bottlenecks, then implement solutions

Develop and lead creative strategy (angles, hooks, messaging, offers)

Work closely with media buyers and designers to align creatives with on-site experience

Continuously test headlines, offers, layouts, and UX to improve CVR and AOV



What We’re Looking For:



Proven experience working with e-commerce brands (DTC preferred)

Hands-on experience building landing pages (not just giving direction)

Strong copywriting background (direct response focused)

Experience as a creative strategist (angles, hooks, buyer psychology)

Strong understanding of CRO principles and testing frameworks

Experience using Microsoft Clarity or similar tools (Hotjar, etc.)

Ability to interpret data and turn insights into actionable changes

Someone who moves fast, tests often, and focuses on results



Bonus If You Have:



Experience scaling winning funnels

Familiarity with tools like Triple Whale, Google Analytics, or Meta ads



Application Questions (Required):



Please answer all questions below. We will not review applications without detailed responses.



Landing Pages (Show Your Work)

Share 2–4 landing pages you’ve personally built.

For each, include:

Your role (what you specifically did)

The goal of the page

The results (CVR, AOV, revenue, etc.)



CRO Testing Experience

Walk us through a specific A/B test you ran.

What was the hypothesis?

What did you change?

What were the results?

What did you learn?



User Behavior Analysis

Using a tool like Microsoft Clarity or similar, describe a time you identified a conversion issue.

What did you see in the data?

What changes did you make?

What was the outcome?



Creative Strategy & Angles

Give an example of a product or funnel where you developed the creative strategy.

What angle or hook did you choose and why?

How did it translate into the landing page?

What performed best?



Copywriting (Direct Response)

Provide a sample of landing page copy you’ve written (headline + section or full page).

Briefly explain:

Who the target customer was

What pain or desire you focused on

Why you structured it that way

title: Video Editor for Fast Growing E-Commerce Company - Ready to start TODAY!
description:
MUST HAVE E-COMMERCE EXPERIENCE FOR EDITING VIDEOS.



We’re looking for a Video Editor who understands performance — not just aesthetics. Must have E-Commerce experience.



Someone who can turn raw footage, UGC, testimonials, and scripts into scroll-stopping ads that retain attention, tell a story, and convert.



About Us:

We’re a fast-growing DTC skincare brand focused on emotional storytelling, relatable content, and data-backed ad testing. Our videos don’t just “look nice” — they solve real skin problems, build trust, and drive sales.



What You’ll Do:

• Edit high-converting video ads for Meta, TikTok, Amazon, and landing pages

• Take raw UGC, product shots, testimonials, reviews, before/after clips — and turn them into persuasive ads

• Add hooks, subtitles, overlays, proof points, and call-to-actions based on provided scripts/briefs

• Use feedback and performance metrics (CTR, watch time, ROAS) to improve and refine ad versions

• Create multiple variations from the same footage to test different hooks, angles, pacing, and formats



You’d Be a Great Fit If You:

• Think in terms of retention, clarity, storytelling, and conversion — not just visuals

• Have experience editing for DTC brands (beauty, skincare, supplements, self-care is a plus)

• Understand how to build videos around: hook ? story/problem ? solution ? proof ? CTA

• Are comfortable editing content filmed by real people (UGC, phone footage, testimonials)

• Know platform formats and editing styles for TikTok, Reels, ads, and Amazon video placements



Bonus Points If You:

• Have edited ads that performed well (high ROAS, high retention, viral, or successfully scaled)

• Can organize and tag footage, build structured timelines, and create modular editable templates

• Have basic knowledge of direct-response psychology or what makes people click, trust, and buy

• Can repurpose long clips into short ads and short clips into engaging compilations



To Apply, please send:

• A few examples of video ads you’ve edited (preferably performance-focused, not cinematic reels)

• A short note on how you approach editing for conversion vs aesthetics

• Your typical availability (hourly, monthly, or project-based)

title: Video Editor & Content Researcher & Assistant
description:
About the role



We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented Video Editor & Content Researcher to help produce engaging short-form and long-form video content across social media and marketing channels. This role blends hands-on video editing with proactive research to keep our content calendar full of fresh, relevant, on-brand ideas — you won't just be cutting footage, you'll be helping shape what we make next.



What you'll do



Video editing



-Edit raw footage into polished short-form videos (Reels, TikTok, YouTube Shorts) and longer-form pieces

-Add captions, graphics, music, and simple motion elements to keep videos scroll-stopping.

-Color correct and audio balance footage to a consistent, professional standard

-Repurpose long-form content into multiple short clips for different platforms

-Manage version control and organize raw footage, project files, and final exports.  

-AI video creation using online platforms. 



Content research



Research trending topics, formats, hooks, and sounds relevant to our niche

Track competitor and industry accounts to spot content gaps and opportunities

Pull together source material for scripts (studies, statistics, expert quotes) when topics require factual backup

Propose a running list of video ideas and hooks, organized by content pillar/theme

Monitor performance of published videos and summarize what's working to inform future ideas



What we're looking for



Proven experience editing video for social media (portfolio or reel required)

Proficiency with a professional editing tool (e.g. Premiere Pro, Final Cut, CapCut, DaVinci Resolve)

Strong sense of pacing, hooks, and what makes people stop scrolling

Comfortable doing independent research and synthesizing it into clear, usable notes

Self-directed — able to take a general direction and run with it without heavy oversight

Reliable communicator who can hit deadlines and flag issues early



Nice to have

Experience with healthcare, wellness, or personal-brand content

Basic motion graphics or animation skills

Familiarity with analytics tools (Instagram/TikTok/YouTube insights) to inform strategy

Copywriting skills for captions and video scripts



Please send me a response back and let me know why you are a good fit along with one of your hobbies and why you like to do that hobby along with how long you have been doing it.

description:
9am-5pm M-F 



We manage vacation rental properties for owners and list them on Airbnb,

title: Marketing Specialist
description:
PLEASE APPLY HERE: 



Compensation: $1,300 – $1,800 / month USD 



Contractual | California business hours | Compensation is based on experience, depth of B2B SEO/content expertise, and demonstrated results. There is strong potential for compensation growth based on performance and impact within the first 3–6 months. 



THE AMBITION



CDMS is a 17-person environmental, health & safety consulting firm serving California industrial and commercial facilities since 1988. We intend to become the most trusted EHS compliance partner in California, and we're investing seriously to get there. Marketing is one of the main levers, alongside service quality and technical depth.



Two assets are already in motion: a large-scale content and search program across our core services on 
, and a second publication, EHS Career Paths (
), that reaches EHS professionals directly. Until now this work has been handled within the team, without a dedicated owner. This role is that owner.



THE ROLE



Marketing at CDMS is several disciplines running at once: SEO and content operations, local search and reputation, off-site authority building, and the design and conversion work that turns visits into leads. A firm our size can't hire a specialist for each. We need one person who runs it all as a system: doing the project management for the full portfolio of marketing work at CDMS, doing a lot of the core & high leverage work personally & via automations, and working with internal and external partners for the rest.



At CDMS (about two-thirds)



The content pipeline: keep service pages, cluster content, and blog posts moving from draft to published, with our web developer.

Local search and reputation: Google reviews, Business Profile, citations, local landing pages.

Conversion: page design, calls to action, and the authority signals that make a prospect pick up the phone and that make a client pick us for the work.

The weekly dashboard: traffic, rankings, leads. Tell us what the numbers mean, not just what they are.



At EHS Career Paths (about one-third, ramping up)



The publishing engine: articles, newsletter, practitioner interviews, and repurposing each piece across formats and channels.

Growth: outreach to associations and university programs, the LinkedIn presence, and the annual State of EHS in California survey.



Example projects in the first year



Build the local reputation engine: run the Google review program with our project managers and stand up local landing pages, so facilities searching in our service areas find us and trust what they see.

Redesign our highest-traffic service pages for conversion: layout, calls to action, and proof elements, measured in calls and quote requests rather than traffic.

Launch the first State of EHS in California survey: design it, distribute it through associations and university programs, and publish the report as the best California dataset in the field.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



An architect, not an operator. Someone analytical and systems-minded who turns ambiguity into structure instead of waiting for instructions, and who measures themselves on outcomes rather than completed tasks. A power user of AI and modern tools who would rather automate a process than repeat it. Someone who enjoys the problem-solving itself, because we are in the process of figuring out the playbook. Excellent written English is required; the work is audience-facing in English.



THE PROCESS



Our hiring process flexes with each conversation, but the common elements are consistent: a short behavioral assessment, a 12-minute reasoning test, interviews, a review of past work, and reference checks with your former direct managers.

Next Step: To move forward in the hiring process, please complete the assessment below. Once finished, you’ll receive a second assessment. Completion of both is required for consideration.

title: Customer Success Manager / CSM ( SaaS / GoHighLevel )
description:
CUSTOMER SUCCESS MANAGER / CSM — SaaS / GoHighLevel (Full-Time, Remote, Long-Term)



Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed.



ABOUT US

CloseLeadsPro provides a white-label marketing-automation platform (built on GoHighLevel) to creators and businesses in the health & wellness space. Our customers are not technical — they're entrepreneurs building a business. Our whole company runs on one principle: when our customers win, they refer more customers. YOUR JOB IS TO MAKE THEM WIN, SO THEY REFER MORE CUSTOMERS TO US.



Our goal is 1,000 customers in the next 6–12 months, and this role is central to getting there. You won't be doing it alone — you'll have a customer-support teammate and a GoHighLevel tech specialist to lean on when you need them.



WHAT YOU'LL OWN

- Welcome & onboarding: our customers arrive pre-sold through referrals — walk them through how everything works, get them excited, collect payment, and drive them to their first real win within their first 10 days.

- Proactive customer success: you own a book of customers and reach out BEFORE they have a problem, not after they're frustrated.

- Health tracking: keep our customer health tracker (green/yellow/red) current — know who's thriving, drifting, or about to cancel, and act on it.

- Save the at-risk: red and yellow customers get a call from you. That's the job.

- Coaching calls: run our check-in / strategy calls — make sure customers are happy and help them tweak their content and approach so they get results. We'll train you on our playbook.

- Testimonials & case studies: spot customers who are winning, invite them to a quick 1–2 minute Zoom, and capture it for our website and social proof.

- Answer fast: respond to questions quickly and kindly over chat/email; escalate what you can't solve.

- Help make the product better: track the top customer complaints and suggestions and bring them to the team, so we improve the product together and hit our goal faster.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 4+ years in customer success, account management, client success, or senior BPO customer support.

- You operate independently — senior enough to own this function from day one, not someone who needs daily direction.

- Excellent written and spoken English — you'll be on customer calls and short video interviews.

- Warm, proactive, organized; you follow up without being reminded.

- Comfortable owning numbers (retention, churn, customer health) and reporting them without being asked.

- Coaching / team-lead experience strongly preferred — this role is on track to become our Client Success Lead.

- GoHighLevel / CRM experience is a plus, not a requirement — we'll train you.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time: 8 working hours per day, Monday to Friday (40 hours/week).

- Shift: 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM Philippine time (this overlaps US business hours for customer calls).

- Includes a 1-hour UNPAID lunch break taken outside your 8 working hours.

- Two short paid breaks (about 15 minutes each) are included within your 8 hours.



ANSWER THESE IN YOUR APPLICATION

1. How many accounts have you personally managed at once? What was your check-in rhythm?

2. Tell me about a customer you saved from cancelling. What exactly did you do?

3. What's your English proficiency (spoken + written)? Are you comfortable on video calls?

4. What tools have you used for CRM / support / tracking?



TO APPLY (IMPORTANT)

Record a 2-minute Loom video and include the link. Introduce yourself, then imagine this:

A customer messages you: "I've been paying every month, but honestly I'm barely using it and I'm not seeing results — I'm thinking about cancelling."

You do NOT need to know our product for this — I just want to see how you'd handle the conversation. Reply to them like it's real, then tell me what you'd do next to turn it around.

Start your application with the word GREEN so I know you read this. Applications without a Loom will not be reviewed.

Long-Term Career Opportunity | Amazon FBA



About the Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced Amazon Online Arbitrage (OA) Product Sourcing Specialist to become an important part of our growing Amazon FBA business.

This is not simply another Virtual Assistant position. We are looking for someone who enjoys researching products, analyzing data, identifying profitable opportunities, and helping build a successful long-term business.

Our goal is to develop a long-term partnership with someone who takes pride in their work, enjoys learning, and wants to grow alongside the company. We believe in rewarding hard work, consistency, initiative, and the ability to generate real results.

If you're looking for more than just another VA job and want the opportunity to grow into a leadership role while being rewarded for your contributions, we'd love to hear from you.



Primary Responsibilities

Your primary responsibility will be sourcing profitable Online Arbitrage products that meet our purchasing criteria and contribute to the long-term growth of our Amazon FBA business.

Daily responsibilities include:

• Researching profitable Online Arbitrage opportunities

• Identifying products with strong ROI and long-term sales potential

• Monitoring inventory levels and seller competition

• Identifying products with consistent sales history

• Avoiding products with unnecessary risk

• Using AI tools to improve research efficiency and documentation when appropriate

Our focus is on quality over quantity. We value carefully researched, profitable products rather than a high volume of low-quality leads.

________________________________________

Initial performance expectations include:

• A minimum of 5 qualified product leads per day

• Leads that meet our profitability and purchasing criteria

• Accurate calculations and documentation

• Low error rates

• Reliable communication

• Continuous improvement over time

Quality will always be valued more highly than quantity.

Required Experience



Applicants should have strong working knowledge of:

• SellerAmp SAS

• Amazon FBA fee calculations

title: Follow-Up Accounts Receivable Specialist
description:
The Follow-Up Accounts Receivable Specialist is responsible for resolving outstanding insurance and patient accounts by ensuring timely and accurate reimbursement fro
dicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial payers. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of the medical billing and accounts receivable follow-up process, including claim status, denial management, payment posting review, and payer guidelines. This role requires excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills to identify reimbursement issues and maximize collections.



Responsibilities

1. Perform timely follow-up on outstanding insurance claims and accounts receivable to ensure prompt reimbursement.

2. Investigate and resolve denied, rejected, underpaid, or unpaid claims by reviewing payer policies, medical documentation, and billing records.

3. Work directly with Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, commercial payers, and other third-party insurers to resolve claim issues.

4. Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs), Electronic Remittance Advices (ERAs), and correspondence to determine appropriate follow-up actions.

5. Submit corrected claims, appeals, reconsiderations, and supporting documentation as needed.

6. Monitor and manage assigned AR work queues to meet productivity and aging goals.

7. Verify patient eligibility, benefits, authorization requirements, and payer enrollment issues when necessary.

8. Collaborate with internal departments, providers, and clients to resolve billing discrepancies and improve reimbursement outcomes.

9. Document all account activity accurately and maintain detailed follow-up notes in the billing system.

10. Identify billing trends, recurring denials, and payer issues, escalating concerns and recommending process improvements.

11. Assist with patient billing inquiries and coordinate with collection agencies when appropriate.

12. Generate reports related to accounts receivable follow-up, denials, and collections performance.

13. Maintain compliance with HIPAA, payer regulations, and company policies.

14. Perform other duties as assigned.



Minimum Qualifications

- High school diploma or equivalent required.

- Minimum of 1 year of medical accounts receivable follow-up or insurance collections experience.

- Experience working with Medicare, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.

- Strong knowledge of the medical billing revenue cycle, including claim submission, denials, appeals, EOBs, ERAs, and payer reimbursement guidelines.

- Experience with laboratory, diagnostic, or ancillary services billing preferred.

- Proficiency with medical billing software, clearinghouses, and electronic health record (EHR) systems.

- Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

- Coding certification (AAPC or AHIMA, CPC preferred) is a plus but not required.

- Prior experience using a PBX or multi-line phone system preferred.



Application Process:

1. Send your updated resume

2. Create an introduction video (3-5mins) and answer the following questions:



- A brief introduction about yourself (personal and professional)

- Walk me through how you would handle an insurance claim that has been denied. What steps do you take from identifying the denial to obtaining payment?

- How do you prioritize your follow-up work when managing a large accounts receivable queue with multiple aging claims?

- If you notice the same denial occurring repeatedly for multiple claims, what would you do?
